info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Management API facilitates the update of supplier agreements within the external agency framework. Utilizing this API, businesses can modify specific parameters of supplier agreements, allowing for real-time adjustments to terms and conditions. This capability is essential for financial institutions or organizations that maintain partnerships with external suppliers. Typical consumers include financial analysts and operations teams that require efficient management of supplier contract details.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of an existing supplier agreement identified by its unique resource ID. Clients can provide updated information to ensure that the agreement reflects the latest terms and conditions.

requestBody.description: Updates the supplier agreement with the specified ID. The request body must contain the fields that need to be updated following the specified schema.

200.description: The update was successful and the resource now reflects the changes.
